message: ingress-nginx adds a Strict-Transport-Security header to HTTPS responses for this host unless the controller's ConfigMap turns hsts off. The Gateway needs a filter to send it.

fix.summary: Add the header on the routes attached to the HTTPS listener.
fix.snippet:
filters:
- type: ResponseHeaderModifier
  responseHeaderModifier:
    set:
    - name: Strict-Transport-Security
      value: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains
